source_request: Create a realistic photograph of an adult gathering the edge of a building's shadow into a shallow pleat held at waist height. The shadow should behave like a thin matte layer that still joins the larger shadow on the plaza.
interpreted_intent: A normally intangible shadow has a tactile, foldable presence while remaining connected to its environmental source region
subject: One adult physically gathering a building's shadow
setting: A sunlit paved plaza crossed by a building's shadow
event: The adult pinches two nearby points on the same shadow edge and gathers it into a shallow suspended pleat at waist height
visual_priorities: Two visible fingertip pinches gather one shadow edge
The pleat remains continuously attached to the larger ground shadow
An air gap and self-shadow reveal a shallow fold with depth
The adult's stance, elbows, and hand placement remain physically readable
baseline_prompt_en: A candid full-body photograph of an adult on a sunlit plaza gathering the edge of a building's shadow into a shallow, suspended pleat. The person stands with both feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly flexed, and hips above the midpoint of their stance. Their relaxed shoulders and bent elbows bring both hands to waist height; thumbs and fingertips pinch two nearby points on the same dark edge. The gathered shadow behaves as a thin matte layer, connected without a break to the broad shadow lying across the paving. A narrow air gap and soft self-shadow beneath the pleat reveal its depth. Seen from the illuminated side, both arms, all contact points, and the attached boundary remain distinct.
